info.title: KmerHosting API
info.description: Public API for resources owned by the authenticated KmerHosting account. Sensitive infrastructure operations require an explicit scope, an IPv4 allowlist and an idempotency key. Provider credentials, purchases and account administration remain unavailable.

get.description: Requires `account:usage:read`. Includes product and non-product operations, status, route, operation id and client IPv4.

put.description: Requires the `domains:write` scope and a unique `Idempotency-Key` header.
